name: tetherify

scripts.check: for f in schema.js lib/*.js handlers/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.job:digest: tgcloud run handlers/shipping_query '{ job: "digest", dryRun: true, force: true }'
scripts.job:channel: tgcloud run handlers/shipping_query '{ job: "channel", dryRun: true, force: true }'

description: Telegram bot that reports Iranian USDT prices from ~90 exchanges, filtering out erroneous quotes. Runs on Telegram's serverless platform.
